title: File Path in a File Viewer
description: A file viewer whose lightened $cover bar holds a monospaced trail in a TextFrame, with $truncate on each folder's BreadcrumbLabel, above the source of the file in another TextFrame, so the path lines up with the source. An icon Button with a Tooltip beside the landmark copies the whole path. Use it in a repository or file browser, and use the baseline trail for pages that aren't files.
